_comment: Findings of the three reviewers (navigation, figures, safety) on branch display-fixes @ a710be3fc5, 2026-09-23. The fix agent was stopped at the weekly usage limit; its partial work is on display-fixes-wip @ 7ffaae83fa (unverified).

reviews.checked: Worked read-only in D:/Projects/olympiads-xyz/.claude/worktrees/wf_5df6f811-c48-4 (display-fixes @ a710be3fc5). My scripts are in D:/Projects/olympiads-xyz/tmp/review-nav/. dump-tree.mjs builds the sidebar with the real src/problems/tree.ts through scripts/lib/load-tree.mjs, the same path gatsby and check-navigation use. It runs on all 1906 papers with both overlays, and the published set comes from the generated solutions/*.mdx; output is in all.txt and compact.txt. From that dump I reviewed IPhO, IOAA, IOAA-Jr, APhO, IEPhO, IAO, APAO, EuPhO, IZhO, RMPh, NOF, NAO, Всерусийска/VSERUSIYSKA and VsOA-ru, plus BelPhO, SPbA, Struve, Samara, MosA, USAAAO, ПУ and VsOA-SPb. keys.mjs lists every round-labels.json entry with the papers it covers and their paper.title; I went through the whole file and question-numbers.json entry by entry. Where titles were doubtful I checked the transcribed source text in the main checkout's tmp/tx: RMPh 2017/2018, IPhO 2007, IEPhO 2017 11-4 and 2018, NOF 1999, Всерусийска 2021 sheets, IAO 2013. titles.mjs confirms that all 7725 sidebar rows equal the generated MDX frontmatter titles (0 differ). dupes.mjs and title-rule.mjs find visible number clashes; 74 rows show a number other than the display number. gate-cases.mjs runs checkNavigation() on overlays changed in memory. navigation.test.mjs passes (11/11), and check-navigation.mjs on the branch gives 0 failures with 1 warning (struve-2026-regional-8-day2 is not a paper yet). The IPhO 2016 case Margulan reported is fixed: one 'Теория' node with Задача 1 and 2, and 'Експеримент' with Задача 2. I confirmed these mappings are correct: IPhO/APhO/IZhO/EuPhO question numbers, IPhO 2023–25 experiment q4/q5 → 1/2 (printed Q1/Q2), IEPhO 2019 'grade-N' numbers, and the Всерусийска 'III кръг (национален)' → Регионален етап mapping (mastheads print 'Региональный этап'). No repo files were modified.

findings.title: check-navigation does not fail on the bug Margulan reported: one exam split into separate nodes
findings.evidence: I ran the real checkNavigation() on overlays changed in memory only (D:/Projects/olympiads-xyz/tmp/review-nav/gate-cases.mjs). It does fail when a round label is missing (73 failures) and when a number contradicts a Q-number in paper.title (ipho-2016-theory-2-p1 dropped or set to 3 gives 1 failure). But three changes give 0 failures. (1) Deleting ipho-2025-theory-q2-p1 or ipho-2024-theory-q3-p1 from question-numbers.json: those titles print no number, so the stored 1s collide. yearNodes() then emits one node per paper, 'Теория (ipho-2025-theory-q1)', 'Теория (ipho-2025-theory-q2)' and so on, each showing 'Задача 1'. That is exactly the IPhO 2016 screenshot, and it only produces a stderr warning. (2) papers['ipho-2016-theory-1'] set to the raw title 'IPhO 2016 — Theory Q1 — Two Problems in Mechanics (10 points)' gives 0 failures, although the file's own rule says the raw paper.title is never a label. (3) A suffix that splits Q1 from Q2 gives 0 failures. So a newly shipped one-question paper whose title has no number and lacks an overlay entry brings the reported layout back, and ship.mjs and CI pass.
findings.fix: Make the id-disambiguated-node condition a failure, not a warning. Also fail when a label (round, papers[] or the composed node label) equals or contains paper.title, or contains Latin text outside an allowlist.

findings.title: Titles starting with 'Задача' replace the display number, so the sidebar and page show wrong or duplicate numbers the gate cannot see
findings.evidence: problemLabel() in tree.ts, and the same rule in problems-to-site.mjs, uses the title verbatim whenever it matches /^Задача(?![\p{L}\p{N}])/. The gate compares display numbers, never the visible label. Reproduced in the dumped tree and in the MDX titles: (a) NAO 1998 'IV кръг' (nao-1998-iv) lists 'Задача 1. Слънцето…', 'Задача 2. Визуално двойни звезди.', 'Задача 1. Маси на компонентите на Капела.', 'Задача 2. Маса на галактика'. The stored numbers 'Наблюдателен 1/2' and 'Практически 1/2' are hidden, so one node shows 1, 2, 1, 2. (b) NOF 2019 'IV кръг · контролно 10 × 3 точки': problems p4, p5 and p6 (display 4, 5, 6) all show as 'Задача 3 т.'. (c) NOF 2018 k5: p1 shows as 'Задача 5 т.', so the node reads 5, 2, 3. (d) VsOA-ru 2026 'Регионален етап · 9. клас': p3 shows as 'Задача о максимумах', with no number between 2 and 4. (e) NOF 2018 and 2019 national 10–12: 'Задача – оценка' with no number. PSF 2010 7. клас: 'Задача „три в едно“'. ESF 2011 8. клас: 'Задача II', 'Задача III' next to 'Задача 1'. (f) NOH 2015 III 7. клас shows 'Задача 1. ПЪРВА ЧАСТ' and then 'Задача 1. Злата вещица'. In all, 74 rows show a visible number that differs from the display number (tmp/review-nav/title-rule.mjs).
findings.fix: Use the title verbatim only when its leading number equals the display number, and otherwise prefix 'Задача <display>.'. Also have the gate check the rendered problemLabel() for duplicate or contradictory leading numbers within a node.

findings.title: RMPh 2017 (October exam): Problem 2 appears three times across two nodes; parts A and B are marking schemes
findings.evidence: The node 'Теория · 27 октомври · на английски' holds 'Задача 1. Two paradoxes', 'Задача 2. Theoretical Problem No. 2' (rmph-2018-theory-t2), 'Задача 2A. Theoretical Problem No. 2 – Part A Sir Geoffrey I. Taylor' (rmph-2017-theory-theoretical2parta) and Задача 3. A separate node 'Теория · 27 октомври · на друг език' holds only 'Задача 2B. Problema teoretică nr. 2 – Partea B…' (rmph-2017-theory-theoretical2partb, lang 'other'). The source texts in tmp/tx show that t2 is the full printed Problem 2 ('Theoretical Problem No. 2 / Part A - Sir Geoffrey I. Taylor…'). 2A is headed 'Marking scheme' and 2B 'Barem de evaluare' (the Romanian marking scheme). The question-numbers overlay gives them 2A and 2B as if they were parts of the question, and the language split puts the halves in different nodes. 'на друг език' also does not name the language (Romanian).
findings.fix: In round-labels.json suffixes, mark 2A and 2B as marking-scheme copies, for example 'друг препис (критерии)'. Do not give them 2A/2B next to the full Problem 2. Give lang 'other' a real name in the label.

findings.title: IOAA 2019 observational round listed twice, with alternative tasks and planetarium problems renumbered 6–10
findings.evidence: The IOAA 2019 year has 'Наблюдения · нощен тур' (ioaa-2019-no-final, source NO-problem-final.pdf, Tasks 1–5 plus the p1alt/p2alt alternatives shown as Задача 6 and 7). Next to it is a plain 'Наблюдения' node (ioaa-2019-observational-nabl, 'Observational Problems.pdf'), which is the same NO sheet plus the PL sheet: 'Задача 6. TASK 1/ ALTERNATIVE', 'Задача 7. TASK 2 / ALTERNATIVE', 'Задача 8. PROBLEM 1', 'Задача 9. PROBLEM 2', 'Задача 10. PROBLEM 3'. It also duplicates 'Наблюдения · планетариум' (ioaa-2019-pl-final, PROBLEM 1–3). The printed numbering is Task 1–5, Task 1/2 alternative and Planetarium Problem 1–3. Nothing numbered 6–10 exists. Unlike ipho-2012-theory-8-9, the nabl copy has no 'друг препис' suffix.
findings.fix: Add suffixes['ioaa-2019-observational-nabl'] = 'друг препис (нощен тур и планетариум)'. Give display numbers such as '1 (алт.)'/'2 (алт.)' for the alternatives and 'П1'–'П3' (or 1–3 under a planetarium label) for the planetarium problems.

findings.title: Papers covering several grades are renumbered straight through, against the printed grade-problem numbers
findings.evidence: The overlay's own comment says grade papers restart at 1 and are not renumbered. In one-file, all-grade papers, though, the sidebar and page titles number straight through, and each title contradicts itself. Examples: belpho-2003-iii-3-etap ('Областен етап · 9–11 клас') shows 'Задача 5. 10-1 «Сифон»' … 'Задача 10. 11-2 «Застой»'. belpho-1995-iv-x shows 'Задача 6. 10-1' … 'Задача 15. 11-5', and the same holds for BelPhO 1990–2001 and 2014. vserusiyska-2022-iv-ru22-e ('Заключителен етап · 9–11 клас') shows 'Задача 3. 10 класс. Задача №1. Эффективная масса' and 'Задача 6. 11 класс. Задача №2…'. vserusiyska-2011-iii-region11e shows 'Задача 5. 11 класс. Задача 1…'. nao-1998-iv-x shows 'Задача 5. Ученици X-XII клас, Задача 1'. For comparison, NAO 1999 II кръг already displays 'VII–IX.1' … 'X–XII.5'. question-numbers.json has no entries for any of these papers.
findings.fix: Add display numbers of the form '<grade>-<n>' (for example '11-2', or '10.1' as in Всерусийска 2020) for these problems in question-numbers.json. The gate could also flag problem titles that start with a grade-problem code that differs from the display number.

findings.title: NAO 1998–99 booklet (64 problems from several rounds and two olympiads) is labelled 'I кръг (общински)' under 1998
findings.evidence: round-labels.json maps NAO '|theory' to 'I кръг (общински)', and its only paper is nao-1998-1999-booklet (1998-1999-booklet.pdf, 30 pages). The node '1998 · I кръг (общински)' lists 64 problems, including 'Задача 12. Втори кръг, VII÷IX клас — задача 2', 'Задача 24. Републикански кръг на I НОА (Варна, 2 април 1998 г.)…', 'Задача 36. I кръг на задочната школа по астрономия…' and 'Задача 60. II кръг на II НОА (06.03.1999 г.)…'. So national-round, correspondence-school and 1999 problems all sit under the 1998 municipal round, and the same year also has separate II, III and IV nodes (nao-1998-ii-x, nao-1998-iii-x).
findings.fix: Give the booklet its own label in papers[], for example 'Сборник 1998–1999', instead of the '|theory' round mapping. Better still, drop the '|theory' → I кръг mapping so that a new null-round NAO paper must be labelled by hand.

findings.title: VSERUSIYSKA shows up as a second competition beside Всерусийска (ВсОШ)
findings.evidence: vserusiyska-2011-iii-region11e has competition 'VSERUSIYSKA' although its archiveKey is under 'Физика/Състезания/Всерусийска/2011/'. The sidebar has two physics competitions: 'Всерусийска (ВсОШ)' with 100 problems and 'VSERUSIYSKA (VSERUSIYSKA)' with 6 (no COMPETITION_META entry, raw code shown). The page source reads 'VSERUSIYSKA 2011, Регионален етап, 9–11 клас'. round-labels.json added a rounds['VSERUSIYSKA'] entry, which labels the round but leaves the event split.
findings.fix: Add a presentation-layer competition alias (an overlay mapping VSERUSIYSKA to Всерусийска) that tree.ts and problems-to-site.mjs apply, and have the gate fail on a competition code that has no COMPETITION_META entry.

findings.title: IEPhO: part numbers shown as problem numbers (2017 11. клас '8 9 10') and two different sheets both shown as problem 3 (2018 11. клас)
findings.evidence: 'Експеримент · 11. клас' (2017) reads 1 2 3 5 8 9 10. iepho-2017-experiment-11-4 appears as 'Задача 8. Часть 8. Экспериментальная.', 'Задача 9…' and 'Задача 10…'. The source text (tmp/tx/iepho-2017-experiment-11-4/text/problems.txt) shows a single 'Второй тур' sheet (Страница 1 из 5 … 5 из 5) with 'Часть 1.' to 'Часть 10.'. These are parts 8–10 of problem 4 (file 11_4), so the _unresolved note that 'cannot be told' is settled by the text, and they should read 4.8–4.10. In 2018, '11. клас' reads 1 2.1 2.2 2.3 3 3.1 3.2 3.3 3.4: slinky (3) and the unrelated spectrum sheet (3.1–3.4) look like one problem with its parts.
findings.fix: Map iepho-2017-experiment-11-4-p8/p9/p10 to '4.8', '4.9', '4.10'. For the 2018 spectrum sheet, use a number that does not read as parts of slinky (or a suffix).

findings.title: One event gets different labels across years or grades; the tour name is dropped when a grade has only one tour
findings.evidence: NOF IV кръг: the experiment is plain 'IV кръг' in 2013, 2015, 2016, 2018, 2019, 2022 and 2023, 'IV кръг · експериментална задача 1/2' in 2017, 2024 and 2026, and 'IV кръг · експеримент' in 2006 and 2021. The five-point test is 'IV кръг · петточково контролно' in 2015–2026 but 'IV кръг · теория' for nof-2021-iv-5-kontrolno. The k30 test is plain 'IV кръг' in 2014 (nof-2014-iv-k30). nof-2017-iii-exp2 ('ЕКСПЕРИМЕНТАЛНА ЗАДАЧА № 2') is a gradeless 'III кръг (национален)' node showing Задача 1 and 2. VsOA-ru 2026 Заключителен етап: 10. клас is the test tour ('Тестовый тур'), unlabelled, and 9. клас is the practical tour (only 7 8 9), unlabelled, while 11. клас has '· тест' and '· практически тур'. BelPhO 2021 'Областен етап · 11. клас' is the experiment only. Всерусийска 2024 10./11. клас are experiment only, unlabelled, while 9. клас says '· експеримент'. Всерусийска 2021 9. клас is sheet 2.9.x (second tour) with no 'втори тур' suffix, while 10./11. клас have one. 'смесен тур' is made up from roundType 'mixed' (vsoa-ru-2025-iv-9-prob2025prac9 is the practical tour; also NAO 2009, 2010, NOF 2006). 'Road to IPhO' is an English label.
findings.fix: Name the tour whenever the paper's roundType is not the competition's default (not only on a number collision). Add the missing suffixes and papers[] entries so each IV кръг sitting reads the same every year.

findings.title: The page's source line and the sidebar give the same competition different names
findings.evidence: problems-to-site.mjs COMPETITION_SHORT maps only NOF, NAO, ESF and PSF, so page sources read 'VsOA-ru 2026, Регионален етап, 9. клас', 'Всерусийска 2024, …', 'Samara …', 'SPbA …', 'MosA …', 'NOH …', 'HOOS …', 'Nikola …' and 'VSERUSIYSKA 2011 …'. The sidebar competition nodes use COMPETITION_META short names instead (ВсОА, ВсОШ, СПбАО, МАО, НОХ, ХООС, Никола). A total of 3,000+ pages carry a Latin transliterated code that appears nowhere in the sidebar.
findings.fix: Build paperDescriptor from the same COMPETITION_META short name that tree.ts uses, and have check-navigation compare the two.

findings.title: In-text anchoring puts a figure between two halves of one sentence on about 18 pages
findings.evidence: Checked against master: every figure lands on a paragraph break that master already had (strict per-block comparison: 0 pages with changed paragraph structure). But on some pages the source text breaks the paragraph in mid-sentence, and the figure now sits in that gap. I scanned all pages for a figure whose preceding block ends in ':' ',' or ';' and whose following block starts lowercase or with a sub-item: 18 hits. Examples: (1) solutions/astronomy/iao-2013-theory-alpha/iao-2013-theory-alpha-p4.mdx line 37. Anchor p4-fig1 {field: parts/0/statement, after: 'outskirts of Dubingiai at midday time:'}. The page reads 'at midday time:' [horse photo] 'in winter, in spring, in autumn, and in summer.' In the printed paper (tmp/tx/iao-2013-theory-alpha/text/problems.txt lines 31-37; pdfRect x 449-569 of 595) the photo floats at the right beside lines 4.1-4.2, and the list of seasons continues the sentence. (2) solutions/physics/psf-2019-proletno-9/psf-2019-proletno-9-p3.mdx: the p-V diagram sits between 'газът извършва работа $A' = 1 kJ$,' and 'процесът 2–3 е изобарен…'. (3) solutions/physics/rmph-2018-theory-t1/rmph-2018-theory-t1-p1.mdx line 103: between 'from Fig. 1R(a),' and 'the theorem of variation for the kinetic energy is'. Also nof-2025-ii-8-p1, psf-2002-proletno-8-p3 and psf-2017-proletno-7-p3 (a figure inside an а)/б)/в) enumeration), esf-2019-esenno-11-12-p1, baao-2021-x-p3 (x2), owao-2022-data-analysis-practical-p3, ipho-2022-experiment-exam-q1-english-1-p1, nof-2006-ii-7-p3, nof-2013-iii-10-12-d1-p4, psf-2010-proletno-sp-p3, psf-2019-proletno-9-p3, noh-2010-ii-10-12-p4, noh-2013-iii-10-12-p4 (x3). Nothing is lost and it is not a safety issue, but this is the kind of odd placement Margulan complained about.
findings.fix: In problems-to-site's placement (or in figure-anchors.mjs when choosing a boundary), skip a boundary whose preceding block ends in [,;:] or 'Намерете:'/'Пресметнете:' and whose next block starts lowercase or with a sub-item marker. Move to the next boundary that ends a sentence, or to the end of the enumeration. This fits a float figure beside the lines too.

findings.title: The 428 deduplicated NAO figures lose their descriptive alt text and width/height attributes
findings.evidence: Checked on 208 pages (the dedupOnly set, 428 figures '2->1'): each figure is now shown once, as the inline markdown image, which the generator switches to the newest -vN crop. I found no lost file, no section change and no remaining duplicate (the only remaining duplicate, nao-2023-ii-5-6-p3, is identical in master). But the <figure> block that is now suppressed carried the reviewed long alt plus width/height/loading attributes. The inline markdown image keeps the short caption-like alt and has no intrinsic size, so the page shifts while images load and screen readers get less. Example: solutions/astronomy/nao-2013-iii-9-10/nao-2013-iii-9-10-p1.mdx. Master's alt for p1-fig1-v2.png was 'Графика „Sunspot Area“: сумарна площ на слънчевите петна в части от пл…'; the branch shows ![Сумарна площ на слънчевите петна за периода 1870–2010 г.](…/p1-fig1-v2.png). Also nao-2019-ii-7-8-p4: 'Телескоп А' replaces 'Рефрактор с дълга синя тръба на екваториална монтировка…'. The integration notes cover the styling trade-off but not this.
findings.fix: In newestInlineCrops, when the inline image is rewritten to the figure's crop, render it as the figure's sized (figure alt, width, height, loading=lazy) inside the same inline position, or at least carry over the figure's alt and width/height.

- The width is capped at 100% plus max-width 100%, so nothing is wider than the column.
- The exception is the 920 inline markdown images (first finding).

Unanchored sample, 10 figures. For each, was a correct anchor obviously available?
- nao-2019-ii-5-6 p4-sol-fig2, nao-2009-ii-9-10 p2-sol-fig1, nao-2024-i-11-12 p4-sol-fig2, nao-2021-iii-7-8 p5-sol-fig3: yes. These are statement reprints; 'before the solution' was obvious (last finding).
- nao-2025-i-5-6 p4-sol-fig1: its source rect is wrong (data error); it is a duplicate of the statement photos.
- samara-2014-i-10-11 p2-sol-fig1: not strongly. Рис. 1 renders after Рис. 2; putting it first would have been better.
- nao-2012-iv-st-prak p1-sol-fig2 and psf-2008-proletno-9 p2-fig1: no. An appendix page and a figure at the end of the parts; the default place is fine.
- balkanski-2022 p4-fig1 and esf-2003-esenno-8 p3-fig5: no. The text layer is mojibake, so leaving them unanchored is correct.

Integration fix: nao-2013-iii-9-10-p1 and nao-2019-ii-7-8-p4 now show each figure once, inline, as the -v2 crop. The duplicate problem is gone, but the result is unsized (first finding).

No gatsby build was run; the rendering behaviour comes from the CSS (generalStyles.css, Tailwind 3.4.1 preflight) and the xdm pipeline (src/gatsby/webpack-xdm.js). No repo files were modified.

findings.title: Figures inlined in the text have no size, so they show 2-3x their printed size and figures printed side by side stack vertically (920 images on 391 pages)
findings.evidence: The integration fix (figureShownInline and newestInlineCrops in scripts/problems-to-site.mjs) keeps the text's own inline image and drops the sized figure block. That inline image is plain markdown `![alt](url)` with no --fig-w/--fig-max. The only CSS rule for it is `.markdown img { dark:bg-gray-300 }` (generalStyles.css:443). Tailwind 3.4 preflight then sets `img{display:block;max-width:100%}`, so each image shows at the crop's natural pixel width: a 300 dpi crop is about 3x its printed size, capped at the column width. Measured over all generated MDX: 920 inline R2 images on 391 pages, 870 of them with printed size data. They show at a median 2.24x their printed-size target (p75 3.12x), and 490 are more than 2x. Examples: nao-2001-ii-11-12-p1 p1-fig1 is printed at 21% of the column (target about 137px) but shows at 428px. nao-2001-ii-11-12-p2 p2-fig1 is printed at 48% but shows at the full column. solutions/astronomy/nao-2019-ii-7-8/nao-2019-ii-7-8-p4.mdx lines 20 and 22 hold 5 figures printed as a row of 3 and a row of 2, each 125-170pt wide on PDF page 2 (sized blocks would be 26-35% of the column, 167-226px). They render as 5 stacked blocks, each 522-707px wide. 26 MDX lines hold 2 or more inline images that stack like this. The 'trade-off' in the integration notes is the exact 'images stacked, badly spaced' look Margulan complained about. It now covers every legacy NAO page and more.
findings.fix: In the generator, when a paragraph holds nothing but inline images and each one resolves (by cropKey) to an entry in figures[], replace the paragraph with figureMarkdown() of the newest crop. Wrap several images in one `problem-figure-row`, and keep the italic caption paragraph that follows. 801 of the 852 inline image lines are image-only. For the 51 mixed lines, at least give the the same --fig-w/--fig-max sizing.

findings.title: NOH chemistry solutions: each reaction scheme should sit next to its own step line, but all of them are piled in one stack in the wrong place
findings.evidence: solutions/chemistry/noh-2019-ii-10-12/noh-2019-ii-10-12-p4.mdx: on solutions PDF p.5, p4-sol-fig1..6 are each printed beside their own step (1. А; А→Б; Б→В; В→изопрен; 2.; 3. изопрен→Г). All six are anchored `after: "**2 т.**\n\nЕ → Ж: **2 т.**"`, so the page shows the labels 'А → Б: 2 т.' … 'Е → Ж: 2 т.' followed by six stacked schemes (MDX ~lines 88-114). p4-sol-fig7..10 (Г→Д, Д→Е, Е→Ж, Ж→линалол) are printed on p.6 BEFORE '4. Структурната ф-ла на линалола…'. The page puts them after that heading together with fig11/12, so part 4 looks like it has 6 schemes. solutions/chemistry/noh-2018-ii-10-12/noh-2018-ii-10-12-p3.mdx shows the same pattern: seven lines '(А) → (Б) 2 т.' … '(Ж) → (З) 2 т.', then p3-sol-fig1..7 stacked (lines ~78-106), although on PDF p.3 each scheme is printed on its own '2 т.' line. p3-sol-fig8 (the (З)→(1) scheme) lands after item '2. Продуктът…' instead of beside '(З) → (1) 2 т.'. tmp/figure-anchors/_report.json shows how='after-only' with tb=null (no word before the marker aligned anywhere). ta sits past 6-40 unaligned words, on the next page for noh-2019 ('т 4 структурната ф ла'). inGap then accepts the paragraphs because the gap bags are full of repeated '2 т' tokens. noh-2016-ii-10-12-p4 p4-sol-fig1..5 has the same trace (tb null, gb 86, ga 12) and the same shared anchor. In total, 77 of the 272 anchored NOH figures share an anchor with another figure.
findings.fix: In figure-anchors.mjs locateIn: when one side has no alignment at all (tb or ta null), require the other side to be close (for example ga/gb ≤ 5), or return a failure. Leave number and points tokens ('2', 'т', 'т.', 'p', 'pts') out of the inGap bags. Refuse when 3 or more figures from different heights on one page collapse onto one anchor with no row. Then rerun --paper for noh-2016/2017/2018/2019-ii-10-12.

findings.title: Placeholder images in the text point to a figure id instead of a URL; they render as broken images and the real figure appears somewhere else
findings.evidence: On 9 pages, about 50 inline images target a figure id instead of a URL: `![](p2-sol-fig1)`, `(#p1-sol-fig2)`, `(#)`, `(figure:solutions-p4-…)`, `(ipho-2024-experiment-q4-p1-sol-fig1)`. The xdm/remark pipeline (src/gatsby/webpack-xdm.js) does not resolve them, so each becomes , relative to /problems//solution/, which is a 404 (broken icon plus alt text). figureShownInline does not match them, so the real figure block is emitted as well. Sometimes it lands next to the placeholder, sometimes far from it. rmph-2011-experiment-exp-p2: placeholder p2-sol-fig1 at line 71, block at line 86. ipho-2022-theory-q2-p1: `#p1-sol-fig1` at line 358, block at 405; `#p2-sol-fig1` at 770, block at 716. rmph-2017-theory-theoretical2partb-p2: `![](p2-sol-fig2) **[0,6p]**` at line 85, directly under the block. ipho-2025-theory-q2-p1 has placeholders p13-sol-fig1, p15-sol-fig1, p16-sol-fig1, p18-sol-fig1 and p18-sol-fig2 with no such figure in the problem (its ids stop at p1..p10 and p19), so those are pure broken images. ipho-2024-experiment-q5-p1 has three `(#)` placeholders. The other affected pages are apho-2023-theory-t1-p1, ioaa-2015-data-analysis-…-p1, ipho-2024-experiment-q4-p1 and psf-2005-proletno-sp-p3. These placeholders already existed on master, but they are the one place where the transcriber marked the exact spot for the figure, and the anchor work ignores them.
findings.fix: In problems-to-site.mjs, resolve an inline image whose target is a figure id (`id`, `#id`, `-id`) to that figure. Render figureMarkdown there and count the figure as inline in figureShownInline, so it gets no separate block. Drop a placeholder that does not resolve (`#`, `figure:…`, unknown id), or turn it into its alt text. Never emit a relative .

findings.title: rmph-2017 T2 part B: p2-sol-fig1 is placed one paragraph early
findings.evidence: In solutions/physics/rmph-2017-theory-theoretical2partb/rmph-2017-theory-theoretical2partb-p2.mdx the figure sits after 'volumul discului având raza … $h' = r·dθ·sinθ$' and before '$dv = π·r³·sin³θ·dθ$ [0,1p]'. On the scoring PDF (TheoreticalProblem2PartB.pdf, p.1) the sphere diagram is printed below the dv line, indented to the right. markerOf takes the wide 'volumul discului' line as the line above in the figure's column and skips the short dv line to its left, which does not overlap the figure horizontally. The transcription's own placeholder `![](p2-sol-fig1)` two paragraphs later is at the correct spot.
findings.fix: Covered by resolving id placeholders (see the placeholder finding). Otherwise, in markerOf, treat a text line that ends left of the figure but lies between the line above and the figure's top as the line above.

findings.title: NAO statement figures reprinted in the solutions PDF stay unanchored and land at the end of the solution, after the grading criteria
findings.evidence: 4 of the 10 unanchored figures I sampled follow this pattern. nao-2019-ii-5-6-p4 p4-sol-fig2 is the Sojourner photo; the statement already shows it inline as p4-fig1. It is printed in the solutions PDF p.4 above the reprinted statement, but it renders at MDX line 77, after 'За краен извод … – 1 т.'. nao-2009-ii-9-10-p2 p2-sol-fig1 (733×619) is a copy of the statement's p2-fig1-v3 (722×608) and is shown at the end of the spoiler. nao-2024-i-11-12-p4 p4-sol-fig2 and nao-2021-iii-7-8-p5 p5-sol-fig3 are the same case: the p.8 photo of the crescent Moon and Venus comes after the criteria list. The report trace is tb=null, ta=0 (the first word of the solution), ga 123-222, reason no-aligned-text. 49 unanchored figures have exactly this shape, 32 of them NAO solutions. In print, the only text between such a figure and the solution is the reprinted statement, so `after: null` (before the solution's first paragraph) was an obvious correct anchor. Better still, detect the duplicate of the statement figure and drop it. Related: in nao-2025-i-5-6-p4, 'Снимки 1-3' (p4-sol-fig1) shows after 'Снимки 4-6' and after the criteria. Its source.pdfRect on solutions p.5 covers the text 'Г) Планината Самодива…', not the photos (a data error).
findings.fix: In locateIn, when tb is null and ta equals the first word of the field, return a pick of idx -1 (before the field). Or suppress solution figures that duplicate a statement figure of the same problem.
